what: Work-item-only subset of the Bend statechart runtime, recompiled for this page with bend 2.0.34 from the unchanged WorkItem.bend, plus the unchanged adapter.

build.command: bend src/Runtime.bend -o <out>.mjs, then append bendMetadata filtered from model.json (work-item machine, its types/states/guards, laws L1-L7 plus W1/W4 incident counts)
build.privacy: Device and host nicknames in metadata text are replaced with generic terms; no transition logic is affected.

parity.against: original full Runtime.generated.mjs (git blob 7afb4e16ad3f370a22f34c4ffb935446615205a2) through the same adapter
parity.space: 34 states x 377 events x 3 availability facts (the build.mjs sample space)

scope: Interactive next-state values come from this Bend-emitted JavaScript. The adapter is authored code: it validates the ABI and derives verdict/reason labels. Proofs cover the emitted BendTT book (source_semantics_attested=false); the JS backend and adapter are trusted. The chapter 04 tape is recorded and played back. Nothing here observes or controls a live host.
